pattern: Native password <input> with <label for>, plus a toggle button (aria-pressed).

roles.role: none: password inputs have no ARIA role (exposed as a protected text field)

aria.value: Help text, visible error, Caps Lock warning (while shown), then describedBy ids
"true" only while an error message is shown
"true" while the password is shown; the name stays "Show password"

keyboard.action: Moves to the input, then the toggle.
Shows or hides the password; focus stays on the toggle.

focus: The control boundary shows the focus indicator; the toggle has its own :focus-visible outline.
notes: WCAG 3.3.8 (Accessible Authentication): paste and password managers are allowed by default.
Visibility changes are announced (Password shown / Password hidden); Caps Lock on is announced once per change.
The toggle keeps a constant name with aria-pressed; changing the name as well would be read as a contradiction.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
